(52,31) error TS2345: Argument of type '{ ...; textStyleRanges: readonly TextStyleRange[] | ({ ...; } | { ...; })[]; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ElementUpdate<NonDeleted<ExcalidrawGenericElement>>' — newElementWith is being called on an element typed as generic; type the element as ExcalidrawTextElement (e.g. API.createElement({ type: "text", ... }) returns the text type, or narrow with isTextElement) before calling newElementWith. (82,9) error TS2559: Type '"#e03131"' has no properties in common with type 'Partial<AppState> & { color?: string | undefined; }'. (89,9) error TS2559: Type '"#ffec99"' has no properties in common with type 'Partial<AppState> & { color?: string | undefined; }' — pass an object such as { currentItemStrokeColor: "#e03131" } / { currentItemBackgroundColor: "#ffec99" } (see how actionChangeStrokeColor / actionChangeBackgroundColor read their value). (220,71) error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, but got 2. Keep every test's behaviour; fix types only, and keep the file prettier-clean.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
